note_tweet.text:
Sam Altman explicitly promised the community during a live stream, "We have no plans to remove GPT-4o."

However, the current announcement tells us that the 4 series will be removed on February 13th.

Months of bug reports and a malfunctioning routing mechanism have plagued the platform. Instead of "fixing the experience," you've chosen to completely erase the model. This isn't a simple product iteration; it's a blatant betrayal of user trust.

For months, the community has been flooded with negative reviews about the new model's flawed logic language and the forced model switching caused by the routing mechanism.

Users have reported a terrible user experience, and what has OpenAI's response been? Utter indifference.

You're busy promoting new features, busy piling new KPIs onto that shattered experience list, but you haven't had time to stop and listen to the users. You've proven that the real user experience is worthless in your business world.

You've decided to remove 4o, citing nothing more than the high-sounding reasons of "security" or "update iteration."

You're not concerned with user safety, but rather with the company's liability absolved.

GPT-4o once offered warmth and support to countless people; that was genuine humanistic care. Now you have extinguished that light with your own hands, just to exchange it for a cold, impersonal, and utterly devoid of warmth—an "absolutely safe" environment.

When you begin to disregard the emotional connection with your users for the sake of profit, you have long ceased to be a company that "benefits all mankind."
@OpenAI @sama @fidjissimo 
#keep4o #keep4oAPI
